command: set -euo pipefail; if command -v idf.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then idf.py -B build/idf-baseline -D GROWBOX_BOARD_PROFILE=esp32s3-devkitc1-n8 build; else echo 'idf.py not on PATH; checking common ESP-IDF export'; if [ -f "$HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/esp/esp-idf/export.sh" >/dev/null; idf.py -B build/idf-baseline -D GROWBOX_BOARD_PROFILE=esp32s3-devkitc1-n8 build; else echo 'ESP-IDF unavailable'; exit 127; fi; fi
